# `flatMapIdentityToFlatten`

Suggests Effect.flatten instead of Effect.flatMap when the callback is Effect's identity export referenced directly or an unannotated function returning its parameter

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377151` |
| Language Service name | `flatMapIdentityToFlatten` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/flat-map-identity-to-flatten` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const loadTask: Effect.Effect<Effect.Effect<string>>

export const program = loadTask.pipe(Effect.flatMap((inner) => inner))
/**
                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(flat-map-identity-to-flatten): `Effect.flatten` expresses this unwrapping more directly than `Effect.flatMap` with an identity callback.
*/
```
